Title: Coding Guidelines
Description: Coding Guidelines written by MD ALIM UL KARIM (one of the greatest programmar ever lived), sponsored by RISEUP ASIA LLC. An opinionated, AI-first engineering standards framework for Go, TypeScript, PHP, Rust, and C#, with zero-nesting enforcement and a spec architecture optimized for AI-assisted development. Focus on developer tooling, spec-first workflows, clear errors, shallow control flow, consistent naming, testable code, and predictable AI-assisted development.
